 Chig Okonkwo A Solid TE Option in Week 10 Against Giants 
 1d Link copied! 
 Share: 
 Link copied to clipboard! 
 See RotoBaller at 
 the top of Google 
 Nov 11, 2026, 6:36 PM ET 
Washington Commanders tight end Chig Okonkwo is leading the team in targets (22), catches (19), and yards (219) since quarterback Jayden Daniels returned in Week 5. The 27-year-old tight end is currently in the midst of the best four-game stretch of his career by receiving yards. In addition, over the past three weeks, Okonkwo's 79.5% route share ranks fifth-highest among all tight ends in that span, trailing only George Kittle , Isaiah Likely , Trey McBride , and Brock Bowers . Okonkwo's role in Washington's offense looks to be trending up, though the lack of touchdowns has held down his fantasy ceiling. Okonkwo has a tough matchup on Thursday night against a Giants defense that has allowed the third-fewest receiving yards to tight ends this season. For Week 10, Okonkwo ranks as RotoBaller's TE14. -- Kyle McCarthy
